headline: IDX's Strategy to Block Algo Trading Suspected of Being Improper
summary: The Indonesia Stock Exchange (BEI) will from 6 November 2026 publicly disclose information on suspected stock trading manipulation. The move targets algorithmic trading that is indicated to be improper.
why: The Indonesia Stock Exchange operates the country's main equity market. Trading-integrity measures shape investor confidence in market fairness.
original_headline: Jurus BEI Hadang Algo Trading yang Terindikasi Tak Wajar
